pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and rhomboid dark-pigmented regions with relatively sharp edge gradients on the upper neck and flank, becoming obscured by vegetation in the lower visual field.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored negative-space lattice with clearly defined tri-point and tetra-point junction nodes forming a geometric grid across the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.
